runtime.timingCaveat: No cold-latency claim: a model already loaded at startup is recorded; one separately timed primer precedes all arms, and fixed arm order plus uncontrolled background consumers may affect latency.

indexingLatencyMs.status: reused immutable raw-document index from A

interpretation: A and B each retrieved a relevant document at Top 1 for 14/15 first-repeat queries (93.3%); C did so for 15/15 (100%). All arms retrieved every labeled relevant document by Top 3 and Top 5.
C versus B gained only q-green-lane-title at Top 1, with no regressions. B versus A had no Top-1 gain or regression.
English Top-1 was A/B 10/11 and C 11/11. Spanish and Chinese were 2/2 for every arm; each slice has only two queries and is too small to support generalization.
The corpus is tiny, synthetic and mostly saturated; it includes a designed title-only distinction. No production quality threshold or acceptance decision was defined.
All three repeats produced stable rankings. No labels, prompts or corpus content were tuned after the run.

The model was initially unloaded; the 2598.194 ms primer was separate. Arms then ran warm in fixed order without controlled background load. These timings do not support a cold-start or speed conclusion.
A indexed raw chunks in 773.26456 ms total (median 27.18 ms); C indexed titled chunks in 722.614613 ms total (median 28.56 ms). B explicitly reused A’s index and has no independent indexing duration.

This prototype does not implement the complete title path, provenance, title invalidation, legacy-vector handling or a safe refresh/migration path. Production migration remains gated by upstream maintainer direction and issue #99; #159 remains open. No full CI pass is claimed.
Model choice was gpt-6-luna at high reasoning with fresh contexts. The harness reports no token usage or cost, so no savings or comparison against a stronger implementation is claimed.
developmentAndReview: The staged Luna/high workflow implemented recipe #175, corpus #176, gateway #177, wrappers #178 and harness #179, with coordinator review and serial merging.
Independent Standards and Specification reviews at experiment commit 3eeee1968a6c3f552125ff7244ee80c48bd264e7 found no findings within the bounded prototype.

Review-driven rework covered nullable guards and blank-title fallback; fixture typing, cross-language equivalence and a title-only pair before freeze; SDK seam typing; and evaluation payload, warm-state and unique-query reporting.

A pilot blank-title discrimination result was incorrectly attributed to upstream and later corrected; separate initial formatter, gateway and wrapper behavioral reversals were valid. Full-title callers, provenance, legacy-vector behavior, migration and upstream PR remain gated pending maintainer direction.
